in_hebrew.name: Tildi
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dew from the God Tyd
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tildi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Norse 'Þildi', meaning 'dew from the God Tyd'. In Norse mythology, Tyd was the god of law, justice, and war. The name Tildi was believed to bring good fortune and protection.

In Norse mythology, Tyd was the god of law, justice, and war. The name Tildi was believed to bring good fortune and protection.
